attr.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
attr.desc: In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy's original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows.
attr.inst: Place FiveNightsatFreddys4.exe and/or FiveNightsatFreddys4 HalloweenEdition.exe into fnaf4/gamedata. On first launch you choose which version(s) to set up (both takes several hours). If both are installed, a menu lets you pick which one to play each time.
